note: Raised when a place came to be hidden, deleted and restored from its menu (Roadmap f-place-menu-views). Up front only what hears the gesture and what says the places' foot has something to list, and the registry handed the tidied one once it arrives (`useTidiedViews`): which place, whether a finger rested, the menu's rows, the toast, the foot and `tidyViews` itself are fetched on first use. 1_401 / 514 more than before it (578_120 / 200_516): measured at 579_521 / 201_030. Then the first load came to ask for nothing it does not draw (first-load-asks-for-nothing-it-does-not-draw.md): `tidyViews` is fetched only once the host lists something hidden or deleted, which the frame now follows itself; the rule for who may tidy a place (`placeTidying`) is on `@graview/core` for the menu's rows and the foot both; the bar's event (`PLACE_MENU_EVENT`) is on `@graview/react/provider`. 328 / 197 more up front, measured at 580_884 / 201_595, so 1_729 / 711 more than before the tidying (1.7 KB).
